title: Cubbon Park
setting: Sunday morning. Cubbon Park. Bamboo path. Anika walks fast and you're keeping up. She's pointing at a tree like she's known it for a while.

beats.native: ಇದು Pongamia. ಎಲ್ಲ ಸಮಯ ಹೂವು. Bangalore ನಲ್ಲಿ ಒಳ್ಳೆ ಮರ — ಶಬ್ದ ಕಡಿಮೆ ಮಾಡ್ತೆ.
beats.translit: idu Pongamia. ella samaya hūvu. Bangalore-nalli oḷḷe mara — śabda kaḍime māḍte.
beats.en: This is Pongamia. Flowers all year. Good tree for Bangalore — cuts the noise.
beats.beat: doesn't look at you. looking up.

choices.native: Trees ಬಗ್ಗೆ ಇಷ್ಟು ಗೊತ್ತು ನಿಮಗೆ? ನಿಮ್ಮ subject ಯಾವುದು?
choices.translit: trees baggē iṣṭu gottu nimage? nimma subject yāvudu?
choices.en: You know this much about trees? What's your subject?
Wow, are you a botanist or something?

beats.native: Architect. ಆದರೆ trees ನನ್ನ amma. ಪ್ರತಿ Sunday ಇಲ್ಲಿ ಬರ್ತೀನಿ — ಒಂದು coffee, ಒಂದು ಮರ.
beats.translit: architect. ādare trees nanna amma. prati Sunday illi bartīni — ondu coffee, ondu mara.
beats.en: Architect. But trees are my mother's thing. Every Sunday I come here — one coffee, one tree.

beats.native: Engineer means — what kind of engineer? Coding? ಅಥವಾ ಬೇರೆ?
beats.translit: engineer means — what kind of engineer? coding? athavā bēre?
beats.en: Engineer means — what kind? Coding? Or something else?

choices.native: Software ಸಾರ್... ಸಾರ್ ಅಲ್ಲ. Anika. Sorry. Yes — software. Small startup, Indiranagar.
choices.translit: software sār... sār alla. Anika. sorry. yes — software. small startup, Indiranagar.
choices.en: Software, sir— Anika. Not 'sir.' Sorry. Software. Small startup, Indiranagar.
Boring software stuff. Won't bore you with it.

beats.native: Sir alla. ತುಂಬಾ formal ಆಗ್ತಾ ಇದೀರಿ. Ee Bangalore ನಲ್ಲಿ Anika ಸಾಕು.
beats.translit: sir alla. tumbā formal āgtā idīri. ee Bangalore-nalli Anika sāku.
beats.en: Not 'sir.' You're being too formal. In Bangalore, just Anika is fine.
beats.beat: tucking a strand of hair. trying not to laugh.

beats.native: ಒಂದು homework ಸಾರ್... sorry, [your name]. Conversational Kannada needs practice — every day five sentences with a real person. Not your cook, not your watchman. ಗೆಳೆಯ ಬೇಕು.
beats.translit: ondu homework sār... sorry, [your name]. conversational Kannada needs practice — every day five sentences with a real person. not your cook, not your watchman. geḷeya bēku.
beats.en: One bit of homework, sir — sorry, [you]. Conversational Kannada needs practice — five sentences a day with a real person. Not your cook, not your watchman. A friend.
beats.beat: ಗೆಳೆಯ. she said friend, looking at you.

choices.en: Are friends easy to find in Bangalore? Any recommendations?
